title_en: Regulations on the Expropriation and Compensation of Houses on State-Owned Land

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated for the purposes of regulating the expropriation and compensation of houses on State-owned land, safeguarding the public interest, and protecting the lawful rights and interests of owners of the houses to be expropriated.

Article 2 For the needs of the public interest, where houses owned by entities or individuals on State-owned land are expropriated, the owner of the house to be expropriated (hereinafter referred to as the expropriated person) shall be given fair compensation.
Article 3 The expropriation and compensation of houses shall follow the principles of democratic decision-making, due process, and open results.

Article 4 The people's government at the city or county level shall be responsible for the expropriation and compensation of houses within its administrative area.
The department for house expropriation designated by the people's government at the city or county level (hereinafter referred to as the house expropriation department) shall organize and implement the expropriation and compensation of houses within its administrative area.
The relevant departments of the people's government at the city or county level shall, in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations and the division of duties prescribed by that people's government, cooperate with each other to ensure the smooth progress of the expropriation and compensation of houses.

Article 5 The house expropriation department may entrust a house expropriation implementation unit to undertake the specific work of house expropriation and compensation. The house expropriation implementation unit shall not be for profit.
The house expropriation department shall supervise the house expropriation and compensation acts carried out by the house expropriation implementation unit within the scope of the entrustment, and shall bear legal liability for the consequences of such acts.

Article 6 The people's government at a higher level shall strengthen supervision over the house expropriation and compensation work of the people's government at a lower level.
The competent department of housing and urban-rural development under the State Council and the competent departments of housing and urban-rural development of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, together with the relevant departments such as finance, land and resources, and development and reform at the same level, strengthen guidance on the implementation of house expropriation and compensation.

Article 7 Any organization or individual shall have the right to report to the relevant people's government, the house expropriation department, or other relevant departments any act that violates the provisions of these Regulations. The relevant people's government, the house expropriation department, or other relevant departments that receive such a report shall promptly verify and handle it.
The supervisory authorities shall strengthen supervision over the governments, relevant departments or units, and their staff members that participate in the work of house expropriation and compensation.

Article 9 The various construction activities for which house expropriation is truly necessary under Article 8 of these Regulations shall conform to the national economic and social development plan, the general land use plan, the urban and rural plan, and the special plan. The construction of indemnificatory housing projects and the renovation of old urban areas shall be incorporated into the annual plan for national economic and social development at the city or county level.
When formulating the national economic and social development plan, the general land use plan, the urban and rural plan, and the special plan, public opinions shall be extensively solicited, and scientific demonstration shall be carried out.

Article 10 The house expropriation department shall draft an expropriation compensation plan and submit it to the people's government at the city or county level.
The people's government at the city or county level shall organize the relevant departments to demonstrate the expropriation compensation plan, publish it, and solicit public opinions. The period for soliciting opinions shall not be less than 30 days.

Article 11 The people's government at the city or county level shall promptly publish the circumstances of the opinions solicited and the modifications made based on public opinions.
Where house expropriation is necessary for the renovation of old urban areas, and the majority of the expropriated persons consider that the expropriation compensation plan does not conform to the provisions of these Regulations, the people's government at the city or county level shall organize a hearing with the participation of the expropriated persons and public representatives, and shall modify the plan based on the outcome of the hearing.

Article 12 Before making a decision on house expropriation, the people's government at the city or county level shall conduct a social stability risk assessment in accordance with relevant provisions; where the decision on house expropriation involves a large number of expropriated persons, it shall be discussed and decided at an executive meeting of the government.
Before making a decision on house expropriation, the compensation expenses for expropriation shall be fully in place, deposited in a special account, and used exclusively for that purpose.

Article 13 After making a decision on house expropriation, the people's government at the city or county level shall promptly announce it. The announcement shall specify the expropriation compensation plan and the rights to administrative reconsideration and administrative action, among other matters.
The people's government at the city or county level and the house expropriation department shall conduct a good job of publicity and explanation regarding the house expropriation and compensation.
Where a house is expropriated according to law, the right to the use of State-owned land shall be recovered at the same time.

Article 14 Where an expropriated person refuses to accept the decision on house expropriation made by the people's government at the city or county level, he may apply for administrative reconsideration according to law, or may file an administrative action according to law.

Article 15 The house expropriation department shall organize investigation and registration of the ownership, location, use, floor area, and other conditions of the houses within the scope of house expropriation, and the expropriated persons shall cooperate. The investigation results shall be published to the expropriated persons within the scope of house expropriation.

Article 16 After the scope of house expropriation is determined, no acts that improperly increase compensation expenses, such as constructing new houses, expanding or rebuilding houses, or changing the use of houses, shall be carried out within the scope of house expropriation; where such acts are carried out in violation of the provisions, no compensation shall be given.
The house expropriation department shall notify the relevant departments in writing to suspend the handling of relevant procedures for the matters listed in the preceding paragraph. The written notice suspending the handling of relevant procedures shall specify the suspension period. The suspension period shall not exceed one year at most.

Article 18 Where an individual residential house is expropriated and the expropriated person meets the conditions for housing security, the people's government at the city or county level that made the decision on house expropriation shall give priority to housing security. The specific measures shall be formulated by the provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.

Article 19 The compensation for the value of the expropriated house shall not be lower than the market price of similar real estate on the date of the announcement of the decision on house expropriation. The value of the expropriated house shall be assessed and determined by a real estate price appraisal institution with corresponding qualifications in accordance with the house expropriation appraisal method.
Where there is any objection to the assessed value of the expropriated house, an application for review appraisal may be made to the real estate price appraisal institution. Where there is any objection to the review result, an application for expert evaluation may be made to the expert committee on real estate price appraisal.
The house expropriation appraisal method shall be formulated by the competent department of housing and urban-rural development under the State Council, and during the formulation process, opinions shall be publicly solicited.

Article 20 The real estate price appraisal institution shall be selected by the expropriated persons through consultation; where consultation fails, it shall be determined by means such as majority decision or random selection, and the specific measures shall be formulated by the provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.
The real estate price appraisal institution shall carry out the house expropriation appraisal work independently, objectively, and impartially, and no unit or individual may interfere.

Article 21 The expropriated person may choose monetary compensation or property right exchange for houses.
Where the expropriated person chooses property right exchange for houses, the people's government at the city or county level shall provide houses for property right exchange, and shall calculate and settle the difference between the value of the expropriated house and the value of the house for property right exchange with the expropriated person.
Where individual residential houses are expropriated due to the renovation of old urban areas, and the expropriated person chooses property right exchange for houses within the renovation area, the people's government at the city or county level that made the decision on house expropriation shall provide houses in the renovation area or in an adjacent area.

Article 22 Where relocation is caused by house expropriation, the house expropriation department shall pay relocation expenses to the expropriated person; where property right exchange for houses is chosen, before delivery of the house for property right exchange, the house expropriation department shall pay temporary resettlement expenses to the expropriated person or provide transitional housing.

Article 23 Compensation for losses from suspension of production and business caused by house expropriation shall be determined based on factors such as the benefits before the house expropriation and the period of suspension of production and business. The specific measures shall be formulated by the provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.

Article 24 The people's government at the city or county level and its relevant departments shall strengthen supervision and management over construction activities according to law, and shall handle according to law any construction that violates urban and rural plans.
Before making a decision on house expropriation, the people's government at the city or county level shall organize the relevant departments to investigate, identify, and handle the unregistered buildings within the expropriation scope according to law. Buildings identified as lawful and temporary buildings that have not exceeded the approved period shall be compensated; buildings identified as illegal and temporary buildings that have exceeded the approved period shall not be compensated.

Article 25 The house expropriation department shall, in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations, conclude a compensation agreement with the expropriated person on matters such as the compensation method, the amount of compensation and the payment period, the location and floor area of the house for property right exchange, relocation expenses, temporary resettlement expenses or transitional housing, losses from suspension of production and business, the relocation period, the transition method, and the transition period.
After the compensation agreement is concluded, where one party fails to perform the obligations stipulated in the compensation agreement, the other party may file a lawsuit according to law.

Article 26 Where the house expropriation department and the expropriated person fail to reach a compensation agreement within the signing period specified in the expropriation compensation plan, or where the ownership of the expropriated house is unclear, the house expropriation department shall submit a request to the people's government at the city or county level that made the decision on house expropriation to make a compensation decision in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations and the expropriation compensation plan, and shall announce it within the scope of house expropriation.
The compensation decision shall be fair and shall include the matters concerning the compensation agreement as provided for in paragraph 1 of Article 25 of these Regulations.
Where the expropriated person refuses to accept the compensation decision, he may apply for administrative reconsideration according to law, or may file an administrative action according to law.

Article 27 The implementation of house expropriation shall be based on the principle of compensation first, relocation later.
After the people's government at the city or county level that made the decision on house expropriation gives compensation to the expropriated person, the expropriated person shall complete the relocation within the relocation period stipulated in the compensation agreement or determined in the compensation decision.
No unit or individual may use violence, threats, or illegal means such as interrupting water supply, heating, gas supply, power supply, and road access in violation of regulations to force the expropriated person to relocate. Construction units are prohibited from participating in relocation activities.

Article 28 Where the expropriated person neither applies for administrative reconsideration nor files an administrative action within the statutory period, and also fails to relocate within the period specified in the compensation decision, the people's government at the city or county level that made the decision on house expropriation shall apply to the People's Court for compulsory execution according to law.
The application for compulsory execution shall be accompanied by materials such as the compensation amount and the special account number, the location and floor area of the house for property right exchange and the transitional housing.

Article 29 The house expropriation department shall establish a file on house expropriation compensation according to law, and shall publish the compensation situation for each household to the expropriated persons within the scope of house expropriation.
The auditing authorities shall strengthen supervision over the management and use of expropriation compensation expenses, and shall publish the audit results.

Article 30 Where staff members of the people's government at the city or county level and the house expropriation department fail to perform their duties as provided for in these Regulations in the work of house expropriation and compensation, or abuse their power, neglect their duties, or engage in malpractice for personal gain, the people's government at a higher level or the people's government at the same level shall order them to make corrections and circulate a notice of criticism; where losses are caused, they shall bear compensation liability according to law; the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given sanctions according to law; where a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 31 Where illegal means such as violence, threats, or interrupting water supply, heating, gas supply, power supply, and road access in violation of regulations are used to force the expropriated person to relocate, causing losses, the responsible party shall bear compensation liability according to law; where the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible constitute a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; where no crime is constituted, sanctions shall be given according to law; where the act constitutes a violation of public security administration, a public security administration penalty shall be imposed according to law.

Article 32 Where violence, threats, or other methods are used to obstruct the house expropriation and compensation work carried out according to law, and a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; where the act constitutes a violation of public security administration, a public security administration penalty shall be imposed according to law.

Article 33 Where expropriation compensation expenses are embezzled, misappropriated, privately distributed, withheld, or defaulted upon, the responsible party shall be ordered to make corrections, the relevant funds shall be recovered, the illegal gains shall be returned within a time limit, the relevant responsible units shall be given a circulating notice of criticism or a warning; where losses are caused, compensation liability shall be borne according to law; where the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible constitute a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; where no crime is constituted, sanctions shall be given according to law.

Article 34 Where a real estate price appraisal institution or a real estate appraiser issues a false evaluation report or an evaluation report with major errors, the issuing authority shall order corrections within a time limit, give a warning, impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan on the real estate price appraisal institution, and impose a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 30,000 yuan on the real estate appraiser, and record it in the credit file; if the circumstances are serious, the qualification certificate or registration certificate shall be revoked; where losses are caused, compensation liability shall be borne according to law; where a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 35 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. The Regulations on the Administration of Urban House Demolition and Relocation promulgated by the State Council on June 13, 2001 shall be abolished at the same time. For projects that have lawfully obtained a house demolition and relocation permit before these Regulations come into force, the original provisions shall continue to apply, but the government shall not instruct the relevant departments to carry out compulsory demolition and relocation.
